newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Chatham County, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Chatham County, N.C..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North

Carolina 27603-1385 until 11 o'clock A.M., North Carolina Time, such bids to be opened in public at said time and place o said day, for the purchase of the following bonds of the County of Chatham, North Carolina:
Dated October 1, 1996 and maturing (subject to the right o prior redemption) annually, April 1, as follows:
$500,000 1998 to 2011, inclusive, $600,000 2012, $1,700,00 2013 to 2015, inclusive, and $1,300,000 2016. There will be no auction.
Dated October 1, 1996 and maturing (subject to the right o prior redemption and to adjustment as hereinafter set forth) annually, May 1 as follows:
* The County has reserved the right to increase or decrease the aggregate principal amount of the bonds by an amount not to exceed $500,000 following the opening of bids.

The County also has reserved the right to increase or decrease the principal amount of any maturity of the bonds by an amount not to exceed $75,000 per maturity following the opening of bids. In the event of an increase or decrease in the aggregate principal amount of the bonds, the purchase price of the bonds will be accordingly increased or decreased by the amount of such increase or decrease.

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notices of Sale and Bid Forms relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919/733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form.
